summary: v1.4.8 Cloud Compute Node overhaul — full backend + frontend validation. 12/12 pytest backend cases PASS, all required frontend testids present on /mobile (engage-node-btn, live-reward-drip-card, smart-battery-card, toggle-allow-on-battery, mobile-tabs, pending-verification, available-balance). Tab switching works (Node ↔ Rewards ↔ Advanced). Vocab purge clean on Compute Node tab (no mining/hashrate/RandomX/share/TGC/H/s). Admin Real-Android tab shows 3 explicit lanes (lane-backend-compute / lane-mobile-compute / lane-total-compute) with labeled rows. APK v1.4.8 (377.2 KB) reachable at /grid-worker-v1.4.8.apk, native_lib_embedded=true, sha256=b32745fff…. Regression OK on /api/auth/me, /api/auth/refresh, /api/pool/health, /api/admin/console/snapshot.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2000+ lines and should be split into routers/domain modules (auth, devices, wallet, tasks) for maintainability; current single-file pattern crosses the 700-line guideline by a wide margin.

Hash validation: HeartbeatIn.node_state and mining_status normalization is duplicated between Pydantic-allowed enum and server-side coercion — consider a single Literal type with a custom validator to keep the contract in one place.
Cosmetic drip on Mobile.jsx is MOCKED — user is informed via 'Visual projection while your node is engaged · settles into Pending after verification' microcopy, which is acceptable per spec.
Admin /admin shows a 6-stage boot animation that delays interactive content ~6-8s on first visit — consider shortening for operator efficiency.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_v148_device under worker user via /api/devices/register (used in heartbeat regression). Not cleaned up but isolated by name prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v1.4.8 features verified end-to-end on preview URL. Mocked element: Live Estimated Rewards drip counter on /mobile is cosmetic-only per user spec. Bridge counters (bridge_active_workers / bridge_*_shares) remain 0 in /api/admin/mobile-mining/metrics until a real Android phone connects via WS — expected. Boot animation on /admin takes 6-8s; click 'Real Android' tab to reveal MobileMiningMetricsCard with 3 lanes.
